support_claim: Commercial notes record that Oakfield rebranded from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH without changing Handelsregister number HRB 88421, and the MSA-OAK-2018 header names Oakfield Logistics GmbH as counterparty.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity rather than mere compatibility. The packet cites an explicit rebrand continuity statement tied to a stable registry identifier, linking the contract counterparty name to the billing referent as one legal entity; the distinctness burden is not met and no missing-information flag blocks closure.
